scope: Add an offline, immutable and hash-bound strict-R3 runtime checkpoint that binds one decision timestamp to sealed score references, frozen Geometry/K9 identity, Robust-21/MC1 calibration inputs, recent IC/global-shift inputs, portfolio/open-position state, Adaptive Exit decisions, and the complete persisted causal feature-state bundle.
